workspace.description: The workspace, by the slug list_workspaces answered, whose skills to list or whose GitHub installation reads a source; leave it out where the member belongs to one workspace alone.

source.description: What to install from, as the member would paste it into Add skill: a GitHub repository (owner/name or its address), a link to one of its folders, an `npx skills add` line naming one, or a skill's own SKILL.md text.

scope.description: Whose the skills are: personal, the member's alone in every workspace they belong to; or workspace, offered to the agents of every member of the workspace, never in the member's personal workspace.

skills.description: The skills to install by name, as preview_skill_install listed them; at least one.

sha.description: The commit preview_skill_install answered, so the files installed are the ones the member was shown.

name.description: The name to install the skill by, such as the one preview_skill_install read from its frontmatter.

summary.description: The summary to install the skill by, which tells agents when to use it, such as the one preview_skill_install read from its frontmatter.

install.description: What to install, by the kind preview_skill_install answered for the source: source with the skills and the commit sha it answered, or text with the name and summary to install the skill by.
